name: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B
description: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B is a 9 billion parameter model that can generate images from text descriptions and supports multi-reference editing capabilities.

input.prompt: A surreal underwater or cosmic garden scene with bioluminescent flora

code_snippets.label: curl
code_snippets.code:
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-9b \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {API_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
  -F "prompt=a sunset at the alps" \
  -F steps=25 \
  -F width=1024 \
  -F height=1024
